slice.target: Determine whether Cargo --offline with an existing lockfile and already-local registry package payload/source can avoid needing registry/index metadata.
slice.result: The pinned offline.rs file does not contain a direct test of the target case: an already-existing Cargo.lock plus locally available registry package payload/source while registry/index metadata is absent. It does show that cached/downloaded registry packages can be used successfully with --offline when Cargo performs resolution, and separately that --locked/--frozen fail when Cargo.lock is missing. Because the file never removes or withholds registry/index metadata after creating a lockfile, this lookup cannot establish that an existing lockfile eliminates the index requirement, nor that it does not.
slice.verified_scope: Exactly rust-lang/cargo tests/testsuite/offline.rs at commit 8814ead110e36ed8fdcf1fdd4009baf82bd78523, including the cached/downloaded dependency offline tests and the no-lock --locked/--frozen tests present in that file.
slice.not_verified_scope: Cargo implementation behavior for an existing lockfile when registry/index metadata is missing; sparse-vs-git registry differences; arbitrary Cargo versions; actual Chat-native Cargo execution; cache population; vendoring; or end-to-end richer-mode parity.

scope_guard: Do not infer from the absence of a direct test that Cargo either requires or does not require registry/index metadata in the existing-lockfile case. Preserve the distinction between package payload/source availability and registry/index metadata availability.

hard_gate_assessment.positive_evidence_scope: Official source-level evidence-gap classification only; no end-to-end Chat parity claim.
